info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Institution OAuth URLs Management API
info.description: The Institution OAuth URLs Management API enables the seamless generation and management of OAuth URLs for specified financial institutions. This API facilitates businesses in configuring secure access to their resources via OAuth protocols, ensuring that only authorized applications interact with their systems. Typical consumers include financial technology providers and business applications that integrate with various institutions to access user data securely. Using this API, developers can streamline user authentication processes, enhancing security and user experience.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to generate an OAuth URL for the specified institution, enabling secure authentication and data access. Make sure to provide the necessary parameters to successfully create the URL.

requestBody.description: This endpoint allows you to create OAuth URLs for a specific institution identified by RES-100045. The request should contain information regarding the OAuth URLs to be generated.
